tweets.text:
Protecting the Homeland is a team effort. 

Today, Acting Deputy Commissioner Ron Vitiello toured the Dilley Immigration Processing Center and met with ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations (ERO) personnel, contract staff, and other dedicated professionals who keep the facility operating safely and effectively. Facilities like this are essential to maintaining secure borders and supporting an immigration system that serves Americans.

The work being done at facilities such as Dilley requires constant coordination, professionalism, and commitment from the many individuals responsible for ensuring operations are carried out with security, efficiency, and respect for the rule of law.

Acting Deputy Commissioner Vitiello appreciates the opportunity to engage with this outstanding team and extends his gratitude for their service, dedication, and continued commitment to protecting our nation and upholding the laws of the United States.
